title: Israeli Strikes Kill 5 in Gaza City — Municipal Park and Tel al-Hawa Vehicle Strike
detail: On Monday, August 31, 2026, Israeli airstrikes killed at least five Palestinians in two separate incidents in Gaza City. The first strike hit a crowd near the municipal public park, an area packed with displaced families, killing two people and wounding several others. A second strike later the same day hit a vehicle in the Tel al-Hawa neighborhood of western Gaza City, killing at least three more people. The Israeli military said both strikes targeted Hamas militants but gave no further details. Gaza health officials said more than 1,300 Palestinians have now been killed since the October 2025 ceasefire took effect, against roughly four Israeli soldiers over the same period. A relative of one of the victims, Amjad Abu Abdo, said: 'There is no ceasefire. There is not one good day in Gaza since October 7 [2023]. I swear, we do not sleep from the sound of drones. You sleep scared of being hit.'

media.caption: Funeral for victims of the Gaza City strikes at Al-Shifa Hospital, August 31, 2026

confidenceReason: Casualty count and locations corroborated by Al-Monitor, an AP wire report via Yahoo News, and Middle East Monitor citing Gaza health officials; IDF confirmed both strikes occurred and claimed Hamas targets without providing details.

title: IDF Shoots Four Palestinians Including Two Minors Guarding Settler Raid Near Ramallah; Settlers Beat Woman and Child in Burqa; Police Seek Warrants for Qusra Attackers
detail: Overnight into Monday, August 31, 2026, IDF soldiers shot and wounded four Palestinians, including two minors, with live fire near Ramallah in the West Bank while providing security for a settler operation in which settlers besieged a house and stole equipment from its yard, according to Palestinian medics. Separately the same day, Israeli settlers broke into a home on the outskirts of the central West Bank village of Burqa and beat a woman and a child, according to village mayor Sayel Kanaan; the attackers also attempted to set fire to a tractor, a vehicle scrapyard and a sheep pen. Israeli soldiers who arrived at the scene arrested only Palestinians, not the Israeli attackers, according to the Palestinian news agency Wafa. In a related development, Israeli police asked a court to issue arrest warrants for settlers suspected of involvement in Saturday's storming of a Palestinian home in Qusra, after a High Court petition filed by 10 Palestinian residents alleged settlers had repeatedly attacked the village while the military failed to enforce its own closure order; the suspects remained in the village and no arrests had been made as of Monday.

media.caption: Medical treatment for a Palestinian wounded during an IDF-escorted settler operation near Ramallah, West Bank, August 31, 2026

confidenceReason: The Ramallah-area shooting and Qusra arrest-warrant request are both independently confirmed by Haaretz's own reporting; the Burqa attack is confirmed by village mayor Sayel Kanaan as reported in the Times of Israel liveblog and corroborated by Wafa via IMEMC; IDF has not disputed that its forces were present during the settler operations.
